findings.detail: The reviewing actor has more than one name. The question calls it Claude Code, options A and E call it Claude, and the reason for option B calls it the model. The question, the options and the reasons should use one name throughout.

blind_answer.reason: When detailed instructions alone still produce inconsistent output, few-shot examples are the most effective fix. Option C directly shows the complete format with location, issue, severity, and suggested fix. Option B gives 2-4 examples across different finding types, all in one complete format, so the model applies that format to every kind of finding. Option A (vague exhortation), option D (longer rules, more of what already failed) and option E (batching doesn't affect format, and adds latency to PR review) would not fix the inconsistency.
